---
title: "Chapter 5 Data visualization"
---
```{r}
{r}
library(nycflights13)
library(tidyverse)
```




nycflights13::flights

filter(flights, month == 1, day == 1)

(jan1 <- filter(flights, month == 1, day == 1))

(dec25 <- filter(flights, month == 12, day == 25))

nov_dec <- filter(flights, month %in% c(11, 12))

(arr_120 <- filter(flights, arr_delay > 120))

filter(flights, dest == "IAH" | dest == "HOU")

filter(flights, flights$carrier %in% c("DL", "UA", "AA"))  

filter(flights, month %in% c(7, 8, 9))

filter(flights, flights$dep_delay == 0 & flights$arr_delay > 120)

filter(flights, dep_delay >= 60, arr_delay <= 30)

filter(flights, flights$dep_time >= 0000, flights$dep_time <= 0600)

filter(flights, between(dep_time, 0000, 0600))

filter(flights, is.na(dep_time))

arrange(flights, desc(dep_time))

arrange(flights, air_time)


rename(flights, tail_num = tailnum)

select(flights, air_time, year ,everything())

select(flights, contains("TIME"))

(x <- 1:10)

(summarize(flights, delay = mean(dep_delay, na.rm = TRUE)))

(summarize(
  group_by(flights, year, month, day),
  delay = mean(dep_delay, na.rm = TRUE)
))
